title: eBay listings
description: Two row types share one dataset: item (one eBay listing from a search page or an item page, charged) and status (one per keyword or URL, free).

dataset.title: eBay listings
dataset.description: One row per listing with its price, shipping, condition, buying format, demand signals and seller, plus status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error, filtered and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
